newsitem.title: UK: BoE gives 1.134 bln stg total help to money mkt.
newsitem.headline: BoE gives 1.134 bln stg total help to money mkt.

text.p: The Bank of England provided the UK money market with assistance totalling 809 million stg in Monday afternoon operations.
It allotted 506 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before July 1 and 305 million stg in repos to June 30 and July 1.
That followed an early round of assistance totalling 285 million stg and midday operations of 40 million.
That gives a grand total of 1.134 billion stg of help for the money market so far on Monday. The Bank said that discount houses had made no use of the late repo facility by 1350 GMT.
